privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Oschterhas is an app for Easter hunts outdoors. We store as little data as possible.

searchers.title: For searchers
searchers.found: When you mark a bunny as found, we store the time and – only if you enter it – your nickname. The nickname is visible to everyone who opens this hunt.
searchers.noIp: We do not store your IP address. It is only used briefly in memory to slow down misuse.
searchers.location: Your location is only used by your browser to show it on the map. It is never sent to Oschterhas.
searchers.tiles: Your browser loads the map images directly from swisstopo (Swiss Federal Office of Topography) or OpenStreetMap. These services see your IP address.
searchers.storage: Your browser remembers the chosen language locally.

organizers.title: For organizers
organizers.login: Sign-in runs through Peakcode Identity. Oschterhas never receives passwords.
organizers.data: We store name, e-mail address, the assigned hunts, the time of the last sign-in and log entries about changes (e.g. import, reset).

hosting.title: Storage location
hosting.text: Data and backups are stored in Switzerland.
